How it drives

Very slow on GAS, with strong control and a powerful, long BOOST. Its SMV identity makes it the DRIVE BY EAR training car.

Original perk

A Slow-Moving Vehicle that’s not much to look at. Which makes it ideal for blank screen and non-visual driving practice.

common Can also be installed on other cars through PERKULATOR.

Try a build

Start with steady GAS to learn the sound language. CLEAN EXIT offers little control headroom in the standard setup; try a different build only after learning the route.

Practice: COUNTRYSIDE. Explore FULL TANK.

Example SHIFT setup

One legal example moves one point per attribute. Lower CONTROL, BOOST POWER, BOOST TANK; raise TOP SPEED, ACCELERATION, DRIFT. Try the two states on the same section to feel the trade-off.

Set up SHIFT in GARAGE after 1,000 trophies · Shift.
